dataSafety.banner.title: Eminye imininingwane evikelekile ayikwazi ukufundwa
dataSafety.recovery.title: Imininingwane evikelekile ayitholakali
dataSafety.recovery.intro: I-AWA ayikwazanga ukuvula amanye amarekhodi akho abethelwe. Asele njengoba enjalo.
dataSafety.recovery.keyLost: Isihluthulelo sokuvikela sale foni asisatholakali, ngakho amarekhodi abethelwe awakwazi ukuvulwa. Lokhu kungenzeka ngemva kokusetha kabusha noma ukushintsha ukuvikeleka kwefoni.
dataSafety.recovery.authFailed: Amanye amarekhodi awakwazanga ukuqinisekiswa futhi ashiywe njengoba enjalo.
dataSafety.recovery.other: Amanye amarekhodi awakwazanga ukufundwa ngenxa yesinye isizathu.
dataSafety.recovery.safeNote: Kuze kube yilapho lokhu kuqhubeka, i-AWA ayibhali phezu kwalawo marekhodi futhi ayibonisi izilinganiso ezakhiwe ngemininingwane engekho.
dataSafety.recovery.newKeyBody: Amarekhodi amasha azovikelwa ngesihluthulelo esisha. Amarekhodi asevele engafundeki ahlala engafundeki ngaphandle kokuthi ubuyisele isipele.
dataSafety.recovery.discardBody: Lawa marekhodi awasakwazi ukuvulwa. Ukuwasusa akukwazi ukuhlehliswa. Ukubuyisela isipele kuyiyona kuphela indlela yokuwabuyisa.
saveFailure.title: Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza
saveFailure.failedBody: Izinguquko zakho azikwazanga ukulondolozwa. Okufakile kugciniwe: sicela uzame futhi kancane.
saveFailure.unavailableBody: Imininingwane yakho evikelekile ayifundeki njengamanje, ngakho i-AWA ayibhali phezu kwayo futhi lolu shintsho alulondolozwanga. Okufakile kugciniwe. Vula okukhethwa kukho kokubuyisa, bese uzama futhi.
portableBackup.entrySubtitle: Sivikelwe yigama lakho lokungena. Singabuyiswa kule foni noma kweyinye.
portableBackup.createIntro: Imininingwane yakho ivalwa ngegama lokungena owaziyo wedwa, ukuze ifayela libuyiswe kwenye ifoni.
portableBackup.passphraseHint: Okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-10. Amagama ambalwa enza igama lokungena elihle.
portableBackup.lossWarning: Uma ulahlekelwa yilo igama lokungena, isipele asikwazi ukubuyiswa. Akekho, kuhlanganise ne-AWA, ongalisetha kabusha.
portableBackup.errorUnreadable: Amanye amarekhodi awakwazi ukufundwa kule foni, ngakho isipele esiphelele asikwazi ukwenziwa. Akukho okushintshiwe.
portableBackup.restoreIntro: Khetha ifayela lesipele olidale ngaphambilini bese ufaka igama laso lokungena.
portableBackup.confirmBody: Imininingwane yesipele ithatha indawo yemininingwane efanayo kule foni. Amarekhodi angekho esipeleni ahlala njengoba enjalo.
portableBackup.errorVersion: Lesi sipele senziwe yinguqulo entsha ye-AWA.
portableBackup.errorWrong: Igama lokungena alilungile, noma ifayela liyonakele. Akukho okushintshiwe.
portableBackup.errorProfileMissing: Lesi sipele singeseprofayili engekho kule foni. Buyisela kuqala isipele esiyinhloko.
portableBackup.errorStorage: Ukubuyisa akukwazanga ukuqedwa. Imininingwane yakho yangaphambilini igciniwe.
